post.caption:
Radio, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays and gamma rays are one continuum at different frequencies, with no boundaries anywhere along it. The names are labels on a ramp. Long waves bend around obstacles and pass through walls; short ones carry enough energy per wave to knock electrons off atoms. Visible light is an absurdly narrow slice, and we see it because it is what penetrates water and atmosphere best. Our reality is a bandwidth accident.
